name: Burning Ki
body:
Prerequisite(s): Burn and ki pool class features.

Benefit(s): Whenever you would spend 1 point from your ki pool, you can instead accept 1 point of burn.

Special: If you possess both Burning Ki and Elemental Ki, you count each point of burn accepted in place of ki as 3 ki points.
